body:
@oliviertassinari I think we might want to disable argos for now until you have a "good" fix for the jpg issue. Those images have no visual difference from a human eye. We are facing the same issue on react-instantsearch, having to configure DOM selectors is painful for an issue that should be handled at the core of your tool. There might be usecases where this difference and warning makes sense but for most application, it does not.

Can you remind us the exact issue? Is it because we are taking screenshots as JPG instead of PNG?
